sample_unit: standardised search terms applied across five platforms

links.outcome: Readability (FKGL, SMOG) of OD information versus NHS recommended grade 6-8
links.effect: Mean FKGL 11.01 exceeded NHS recommendations (Grades 6–8); only 27.7% of sources met the target; readability poor across all platforms.
links.quote: Mean readability (FKGL 11.01) exceeded NHS recommendations (Grades 6–8), with only 27.7% of sources meeting the target.

links.outcome: Quality of AI-generated olfactory dysfunction information by DISCERN and QAMAI
links.effect: AI content consistently failed high-quality DISCERN standard, especially treatment domains. Claude mean 38.13, 75% low quality; Perplexity 50.56 moderate; ChatGPT 43.00; Gemini 44.94.
links.quote: Google alone produced high-quality OD information by DISCERN criteria; AI-generated content consistently failed to meet this standard, particularly for treatment-related domains.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluating the quality and readability of olfactory dysfunction information provided by various LLM chatbots versus Google search using validated instruments like DISCERN.
